name: Bob Evans Farms - Xenia OH Plant
type: Manufacturing plant (fresh pork sausage rolls & links)

fieldNotes.truckGate: East-side truck yard opens directly onto Birch Rd with no barrier arm, gate, or checkpoint. Street View (2022-06) confirms a wide-open paved apron meeting the public road. The west office/parking driveway is also an open curb cut. No truck gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth structure of any kind at either driveway. Confirmed in Street View from multiple headings.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Plant fronts directly on Birch Rd with minimal setback; the truck approach from road to dock is short, holding only 1-2 trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated 6 visible loading/overhead doors on the east and south building faces from satellite z20 and Street View; older small-footprint plant (~30,000 sq ft core). Low confidence on exact count due to building face angles.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No marked trailer-parking stalls; the east apron is open paved space, not a drop lot.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Xenia surrounded by farm fields, ball fields, and scattered rural residential; classified Rural.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: East paved apron could informally hold ~8 trailers but has no marked stalls; low confidence.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single connected/multi-section plant complex counted as ~4 distinct attached structures plus accessory equipment buildings.
